title: Ghozt
bio:
Leyline Radio w/ Ghozt

*Monthly*

Ghozt is a New York/Connecticut–based producer and sound-artist working across the edges of deconstructed club, left-field club, and industrial electronics. Their sound blends emotional intensity with tight control, shaping tracks that feel physical, charged, and distinctly their own. Ghozt also leads GHOZT DEN, a community-focused series that gathers underground producers and directs proceeds toward humanitarian causes — treating sound design as a shared practice rooted in care and community.
